info.name: Complytude API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Complytude - Multi-tenant NestJS application with JWT authentication (HTTP-only cookies), S3/MinIO file storage, document generation, template management with versioning, plan-based feature enforcement, usage tracking, audit logging, and role-based access control (RBAC).

**Authentication Flow:**
1. Login → Returns tenant list (temp auth cookie set)
2. Tenant Switch → Selects active tenant (access/refresh cookies set)
3. All subsequent requests use cookies automatically

**Version:** 3.0.0
**Last Updated:** 2026-01-25
